correctness.rationale: The two cyclic Fourier modes of C_n × K_2 solve exactly the potential equations for a rung source and a rim source. The explicit positive Green kernel yields four absolute-current column sums; the complementary-column identity gives cycle norms. Exact rational finite-case comparisons and a 0.061 uniform kernel-tail estimate prove the orbit classification for every n≥3; geometric threshold counting establishes the logarithmic coefficient. A separate grounded-Laplacian exact-fraction checker reconstructs 504 edge columns for n=3..18. Finite checks alone do not justify the infinite claims, which have an explicit analytic proof.

A spectral factorization is insufficient by itself to imply an exact absolute-current extremum, whose signs change at a moving logarithmic distance. These comparisons establish a separate claim without attributing general background lemmas as discoveries.

value.rationale: Projection norms on graph edge ℓ1 spaces depend on unsigned transfer-current totals and are not settled by eigenvalues or resistance diagonals. This natural two-layer periodic network admits two inequivalent edge orbits whose maximizing roles switch sharply at n=4, and its whole family has an explicit logarithmic approach to two different limiting norms despite exponential spatial Green decay. These are meaningful infinite-family structural and asymptotic results; the n=4 known cube special case and lack of global minimization are explicitly excluded from the new contribution.
